node.title: Re: Regex to extract alphanumeric strings between pipe delimiter
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Please use tags to format your example input and expected output, and show the code you've tried so far ([id://174051]). In general, it sounds like you probably want to use [mod://Text::CSV] to read the file (with the sep_char set to |), and break down the group and pid with [doc://split] (if it is guaranteed that the strings don't contain any escaped commas, otherwise it's better to use [mod://Text::CSV] for that too), and then loop over the results.
